profile.belief: I have always appreciated entertainment as a way that anyone in the world, no matter what they are going through, can use this outlet as a way to escape from the biggest to smallest of problems. Creating and telling stories broadens the minds of those who may be succumbed to or stuck in their own bubble. Even those in the worst circumstances can have the world at their fingertips.
